title: Record, train, and deploy from one place with Strands Agents, LeRobot, and Hugging Face Storage Buckets
summary: This content introduces a unified workflow combining Strands Agents, LeRobot, and Hugging Face Storage Buckets to streamline the process of recording robot data, training models, and deploying them. It emphasizes a single platform for the entire ML lifecycle, likely targeting robotics and embodied AI practitioners.
